## Introduction
The National Highway Transportation Safety Administration (NHTSA) requires companies operating autonomous vehicle (AV) technology to report collisions.

## Crashes in the US
AV Crashes are reported throughout the country, but the largest single concentration is in San Francisco.  

```{python}
#| column: page-right
#| layout-nrow: 1

fig1 = px.scatter_map(
    crash_geo_sev,
    lat='lat',
    lon='lng',
    size='Total',
    #color='Total',
    #color_continuous_scale='orrd',
    color_discrete_sequence=['#c1121f'],
    size_max=70,
    hover_name='city',
    hover_data=severity_order,
    
    zoom=3
).update_layout(
    map_style="basic",
    margin={"r":0,"t":0,"l":0,"b":0},
    updatemenus=[
        dict(
            buttons=list([
                dict(
                    args=[{"marker.size":crash_geo_sev[severity].to_numpy()}],
                    label=severity,
                    method="restyle",
                ) for severity in ['Total'] + severity_order
            ]),
            bgcolor=None,
            direction="down",
            showactive=True,
            x=0.025,
            xanchor="left",
            y=0.975,
            yanchor="top"
        ),
    ]
)


fig2 = px.scatter_map(
    crash_geo_comp,
    lat='lat',
    lon='lng',
    size='Total',
    #color='Total',
    #color_continuous_scale='orrd',
    color_discrete_sequence=['#003049'],
    size_max=70,
    hover_name='city',
    hover_data=comp_crashtot_descending[:5],
    zoom=3
).update_layout(
    map_style="basic",
    margin={"r":0,"t":0,"l":0,"b":0},
    updatemenus=[
        dict(
            buttons=list([
                dict(
                    args=[{"marker.size":crash_geo_comp[company].to_numpy()}],
                    label=company,
                    method="restyle"
                ) for company in ['Total'] + comp_crashtot_descending 
            ]),
            direction="down",
            showactive=True,
            x=0.025,
            xanchor="left",
            y=0.975,
            yanchor="top",
        ),
    ]
)

fig1.show()
fig2.show()

```

San Francisco **alone** has more crashes than any other state besides California, and has the most crashes of any county in California despite being a geographically small county . San Francisco has X as many collisions as Los Angeles despite being roughly 1/100th the area.

```{python}

)

)

fig3.show()
```

## Crashes in San Francisco
Most crashes result in no injury.  Waymo, the only company operating commercial AV passenger service under a deployment permit, has the most crashes.  Cruise, which also briefly operated commercial AV passenger service under a deployment permit, follows with the second-most number of crashes

:::{.panel-tabset}

## San Francisco

```{python}


crash_disp = (
    crash.loc[crash['city'].eq('San Francisco')]
    .groupby(['operating_entity','highest_injury_severity_alleged_legacy'], as_index=False)
    .size()
    .sort_values(by='size',ascending=False)
    .rename(columns={'size':'crashes'})
)


fig5 = px.bar(
    crash_disp,
    x='operating_entity',
    y='crashes',
    color='highest_injury_severity_alleged_legacy',
    color_discrete_map= lavender_map,
    category_orders = {'highest_injury_severity_alleged_legacy':['No Injuries Reported','Minor','Moderate','Serious','Fatality','Unknown']}
)

fig5.show()
```

## California

```{python}


crash_disp = (
    crash.loc[crash['state'].eq('CA')]
    .groupby(['operating_entity','highest_injury_severity_alleged_legacy'], as_index=False)
    .size()
    .sort_values(by='size',ascending=False)
    .rename(columns={'size':'crashes'})
)

top5 = crash_disp.groupby(['operating_entity']).agg({'crashes':'sum'}).sort_values(by=['crashes'], ascending=False).index[0:5]

crash_disp.loc[~crash_disp['operating_entity'].isin(top5), 'operating_entity'] = "All Others"
crash_disp = (
    crash_disp.groupby(['operating_entity','highest_injury_severity_alleged_legacy'], as_index=False)
    .agg({'crashes':'sum'})
    .sort_values(by='crashes',ascending=False)
)

fig6 = px.bar(
    crash_disp,
    x='operating_entity',
    y='crashes',
    color='highest_injury_severity_alleged_legacy',
    color_discrete_map= lavender_map,
    category_orders = {'highest_injury_severity_alleged_legacy':['No Injuries Reported','Minor','Moderate','Serious','Fatality','Unknown']}
)
fig6.show()
```
